mapper.select: SELECT f.favorite_id AS id, f.product_id AS productId, p.model AS productName, b.brand_name AS brandName, pi.storage_path AS productImage, p.price AS price, p.stock AS stock, p.product_type AS product_type, p.`condition` AS `condition`, pd.parameters AS specifications, f.create_time AS createdAt FROM favorite f LEFT JOIN product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN brand b ON p.brand = b.brand_id LEFT JOIN product_image pri ON p.product_id = pri.product_id AND pri.image_type = 'main' LEFT JOIN sys_image pi ON pri.image_id = pi.id LEFT JOIN product_detail pd ON p.product_id = pd.product_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}
